lines.text: It’s project time! Make a ScratchJr game where a hero collects three treasures that disappear when touched, and says “You win!” at the end.
Your character collects things (gems, apples, coins) around the stage.
Show a score that goes up by 1 for each thing collected.
When everything is collected, say “You win!”.
In ScratchJr, make arrow characters the player taps to move the hero.
Collect all 3 coins with ⭐ +1 each, then say “You win!”.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
